question.text: A <math><mn>25</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mi> </mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math> volume cylinder is filled with <math><mn>1</mn></math> mol of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> gas at room temperature <math><mo>(</mo><mn>300</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mo>)</mo></math> . The molecular diameter of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> , and its root mean square speed, are found to be <math><mn>0.3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> and <math><mn>200</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo>/</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math> , respectively. What is the average collision rate (per second) for an <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> molecule?
